gloss: length and breadth; vertically and horizontally; freely in all directions
notes:
Has two distinct uses: literal (dimensions, grid layout) and figurative (freely, without restriction). The figurative sense, especially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, is common in writing about sports, intellectual ability, and creative work. Also read たてよこ in some contexts, but じゅうおう is the standard reading for the figurative sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦横|じゅうおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧: to run around freely in all directions
- {縦横|じゅうおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to play an active role in every area
- {縦横|じゅうおう}{無尽|むじん}: inexhaustibly in every direction (four-character compound)
- {縦横|じゅうおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate fully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由自在|じゆうじざい}→自由自在：21838_jiyuujizai⟧: freely, at will — emphasizes effortless mastery
- ⟦{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}→縦横無尽：14074_juuoumujin⟧: in all directions without limit — stronger four-character form of the figurative sense

definitions.explanation: the vertical and horizontal dimensions; length and width
freely and without restriction; in every direction; to one's heart's content
